title: Test & demo harness for libs/
description: Give GAS-Core libraries runnable demos + a regression suite. DEMO-CENTRIC model (2026-06-18b, see bd memories test-demo-harness-architecture-pivot-2026-06-18 + test-demo-harness-demo-centric-refinement-2026-06): the deployable unit is a DEMO (examples/demos/<demo>/ with demo.config.json {host, uses[]}) that composes one+ libraries; libs/<Name>/ holds production code + Tier 1 test/ only. A push-demo tool assembles a chosen demo + its uses[] libs and clasp-pushes to a small set of reusable host projects (sheet/doc/standalone) whose scriptIds live in libs/harness-hosts.json. Tiers: Tier 1 node --test (PR gate, per-lib), Tier 2 doGet acceptance vs a host (assert deployment identity first), Tier 3 Playwright smoke. NO aggregator, NO demo vendoring/drift. Retained separately: production-consumer submodule/drift-check (anti-fork).

title: Build submodule + drift-check tooling for LibSheets consumers
description: Prerequisite for all 8 per-project LibSheets migration issues (GAS-Core-9zj, 82p, 1je, brt, het, cia, c4l, ydj). Needs: (1) tag libs/LibSheets at v1.0.0; (2) decide and implement consumer-side mechanism (git submodule recommended per ADR discussion: dirty submodule state gives free drift detection vs a copy/sync script); (3) build a drift-check (pre-push hook or CI step) in consumer repos that fails if the submodule is dirty or not pinned to a known tag. Without this, the migration issues have no mechanism to migrate to.
design: Recommended: git submodule over subtree or sync-script, because a dirty submodule shows up directly in 'git status' of the consumer repo, giving free, zero-tooling drift detection (discussed and agreed in prior session).
close_reason: Tagged v1.0.0 for LibSheets/LibSidebar, decided on git submodule + flat-copy pattern, built reusable check-lib-drift.sh, documented consumer setup steps in README. Per-project wiring is the remaining migration issues.

title: LibSheets harness/demo.js uses Node require() inside entryPoint — breaks under real GAS V8 runtime
description: libs/LibSheets/harness/demo.js's 'headerAliasing' entryPoint calls require('../libSheets.js') to reach the pure helpers. This works under Node (Tier 1 style) but GAS V8 has no require() (verified against https://developers.google.com/apps-script/guides/v8-runtime) — in a real bound/deployed harness (Tier 2, examples/integrated/test-harness/), this entryPoint will throw 'require is not defined' and be caught by the aggregator's try/catch isolation (so it won't break other demos), but the headerAliasing demo itself will never succeed at Tier 2/3. Fix: reference resolveManagedHeaderMap_/buildSharedHeaderCopyPlan_ as globals (GAS shares one global scope across project files) instead of require(), guarded similarly to the module.exports pattern already used for Node. Found while building/verifying the aggregator for GAS-Core-pos.5 (simulated GAS global-scope execution via vm.createContext).
notes: Resolved by the hybrid migration: the obsolete libs/LibSheets/harness/demo.js (pos.4, with the require() entryPoint) is replaced by libs/LibSheets/libSheetsDemo.js (named-function manifest, GAS-V8-safe). Handle in the batch:8-demo-foundation work (GAS-Core-xnc): create libSheetsDemo.js and DELETE harness/demo.js.
close_reason: Resolved by hybrid migration (GAS-Core-xnc): obsolete libs/LibSheets/harness/demo.js (require()-based headerAliasing entryPoint) deleted; replaced by libs/LibSheets/libSheetsDemo.js, a GAS-V8-safe named-function manifest with no require() calls.

title: [TST] Tier 3 Playwright smoke spec vs a deployed per-lib harness
description: Add a Tier 3 Playwright smoke spec driving a deployed PER-LIBRARY harness UI (menu clicks, sidebar/dialogs, nested iframes), reusing best-practices/gas-playwright-testing. Per-lib standalone harness; periodic/manual gate only, not a default PR gate.
notes:
## Tier 3 Playwright Smoke Spec — Current Status & Next Steps

### What's done (2026-06-19)
- **Created**: examples/demos/libsheets-basic/smoke.spec.js (one test: menu click → demo execution)
- **Created**: examples/demos/libsheets-basic/playwright.config.js (headed Chrome, scoped to demo dir)
- **Created**: examples/demos/libsheets-basic/authenticate.js (Google auth helper)
- **Modified**: .gitignore, README.md, package.json
- **Status**: Code staged (not yet committed)
- **Tests validated**: All JS passes node --check; selectors follow best-practice patterns

### Tier 3 scope & design
- Drives the real Sheets editor UI via Playwright (menu clicks, onOpen menu, sidebar)
- Periodic/manual gate only (NOT a default PR gate — too slow, brittle)
- Asserts on visible side effect (sheet tabs created by demo) not just menu presence
- Per-library harness (libsheets-basic demo) — demonstrates single-lib Tier 3 workflow

### Blocker: Manual/headed testing required
Playwright requires:
1. **Network install**: `npm install @playwright/test` (sandboxed in this repo, cannot auto-run)
2. **Live Google auth**: User runs `npx playwright test --headed` once interactively → captures .auth/user.json
3. **Live Sheet URL**: `SHEET_URL=<bound sheet URL> npx playwright test`
4. **Headed browser**: Chrome must be visible (GAS editor nested iframes cannot be driven headless)

**Cannot be automated in CI** — this is the documented trade-off for Tier 3 (real UI coverage, manual/periodic gate).

### Next steps (future work)
1. **Manual verification** (when ready): 
   - Run `npm install @playwright/test` locally
   - Open the bound Sheet in browser (get URL from demo.config.json _execUrl or GAS editor)
   - Run `SHEET_URL='<url>' npx playwright test examples/demos/libsheets-basic/smoke.spec.js --headed`
   - Confirm the test passes (menu appears, click works, demo executes, sheets created)
   
2. **If selectors fail** (Google editor DOM changed):
   - Update selectors in smoke.spec.js (currently #docs-menubar, getByRole('menuitem'/'tab'))
   - Re-run manual test
   
3. **Expand Tier 3** (out of scope, post-MVP):
   - Add tests for libsheets-with-notifications (sidebar interaction)
   - Add tests for other library demos as they mature
   - Document periodic smoke-test CI job (manual trigger, not auto-gate)

4. **Prerequisite**: GAS-Core-2xf must be resolved first (SpreadsheetApp OAuth scope authorization on the Sheet host — currently blocks live doGet/UI access). Once authorized, Tier 2 & Tier 3 become accessible without 403 errors.

### Current blocking issue
**GAS-Core-2xf**: Sheet host needs one-time OAuth consent (user opens the GAS editor, authorizes SpreadsheetApp scope, saves). After that, both Tier 2 (doGet) and Tier 3 (UI) tests can run.

### Files & commands reference
```bash
# Install (once, locally)
npm install @playwright/test

# Capture Google auth (once, locally)
npx playwright test examples/demos/libsheets-basic/smoke.spec.js --headed
# Follow the browser prompt to sign in to Google

# Run smoke test (requires .auth/user.json + live SHEET_URL)
SHEET_URL='https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/...' \
  npx playwright test examples/demos/libsheets-basic/smoke.spec.js --headed
```

### Summary
✅ Playwright smoke spec scaffold complete, code quality validated, design documented
⏸️ Paused further expansion (per user request)
⚠️ Manual testing deferred (requires live browser + auth)
🚫 Cannot auto-gate in CI (by design — Tier 3 is periodic/manual)
close_reason: Added Tier 3 Playwright smoke spec for libsheets-basic demo (menu click + demo execution); periodic/manual gate
